parsed.explanation: Parent regime creates tier-1 traveler exposures: federal single-sex facility exclusion, passport/visa marker restrictions, visa refusal where documents cast doubt on sex, and possible permanent fraud ineligibility, plus documented severe abuse in immigration custody and hostile official framing. These enforced border/document/federal-facility rules govern despite local tolerance. Mitigations are substantial: this state is in a low-risk group, has no bathroom ban and its governor vetoed such bills, municipal and Title VII protections apply, national hate-crime law covers gender identity, and litigation has blocked some orders. Those do not cancel the federal exposures. Locally there is no presentation criminalisation or organised targeting, but no state hate-crime inclusion, a panic defence remains, and visible LGBTQ organizing has deteriorated. Elevated, not high, risk.
